| [King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Gizzard_&_the_Lizard_Wizard) discography | |-| | Studio albums | 27 | [[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Gizzard_%26_the_Lizard_Wizard_discography#cite_note-3) In November 2020, they released their 16th studio album, [_K.G._](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/K.G._(album)), followed by the companion album, [_L.W._](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/L.W._(album)), the following February. On 11 June 2021 they released their 18th studio album, _[Butterfly 3000](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Butterfly_3000)_. After a number of vinyl copies were accidentally sent early to record stores in Europe, their 19th studio album, _[Made in Timeland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Made_in_Timeland)_, was officially released on 5 March 2022. Three days later, their 20th studio album, _[Omnium Gatherum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Omnium_Gatherum_(album))_, was announced. [[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Gizzard_%26_the_Lizard_Wizard_discography#cite_note-4) Their 24th studio album, whose name is shortened to _[PetroDragonic Apocalypse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PetroDragonic_Apocalypse)_, released on 16 June 2023. On 27 September of the same year, they officially announced their 25th studio album, _[The Silver Cord](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Silver_Cord_(King_Gizzard_&_the_Lizard_Wizard_album))_, released on 27 October. In July of 2024, they announced their 26th album, _[Flight b741](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flight_b741)_, released 9 August of that year. ## Albums ### Studio albums | Title | Details | Peak chart positions | |-|-|-| | [AUS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ARIA_Charts)
